project_guess: Syncthing - a continuous file synchronization program

candidate_flows.name: Syncthing Daemon Startup and Continuous Sync
candidate_flows.why_interesting: This is the primary flow of the entire software: initializes configuration, starts synchronization engine, and runs continuously.
evidence: cmd/syncthing/main.go is the main binary entrypoint
lib/syncthing/syncthing.go is a direct dependency containing service orchestration
lib/model/model.go is the core sync model

candidate_flows.name: REST API Request Handling
candidate_flows.trigger: HTTP request to syncthing's REST API (e.g., from web UI or external client)
candidate_flows.why_interesting: The API provides the main user interaction surface and is essential for remote control.
evidence: lib/api/api.go implements ServeHTTP and handler functions

candidate_flows.name: Discovery Server (stdiscosrv) Operation
candidate_flows.why_interesting: Global discovery service for Syncthing peers to find each other.

candidate_flows.name: Relay Server (strelaysrv) Operation
candidate_flows.why_interesting: Relay server enables NAT traversal for syncthing peers.

candidate_flows.name: Crash Report Receiver Background Maintenance
candidate_flows.why_interesting: Infrastructure service that receives and stores crash reports, with periodic cleanup.

candidate_flows.name: Background loop — periodic ticker created
candidate_flows.trigger: local static source-signal threshold was met
candidate_flows.why_interesting: operational flow discovered from background loop source signals across several executables
